headlines.title: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
headlines.summary: The expectation had been for falling rates this year, but the war with Iran and its resulting rise in oil prices upended that.

headlines.title: Trump strikes new drug pricing deals with nine midsized drugmakers
headlines.summary: The string of deals builds on the Trump administration's push to link the nation's drug prices to cheaper ones abroad.

headlines.title: Manhattan s luxury rental market is booming, with units reaching $100,000 a month
headlines.summary: New York City brokers said they've seen a surge in the number of wealthy renters, which is driving Manhattan rents to new records.

headlines.title: The choose your own adventure earnings: Why retailers are handling tariff refunds so differently
headlines.summary: Retailers have diverged on how they've reported tariff refunds in their earnings this quarter, with some choosing to lower prices and others boosting margins.

headlines.title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
headlines.summary: The tire maker has an ongoing turnaround plan as the company tries to restructure its business, refinance and pay down years of debt.

headlines.title: Imax says it s open to a sale. Why is no one buying?
headlines.summary: Imax's stock and box office are breaking records, but studio conflicts and a soaring valuation complicate the list of who could bid for the company.

headlines.title: How Taylor Farms became integral to America s food supply system
headlines.summary: Taylor Farms and other suppliers have become larger and more integral to the U.S. food system, complicating foodborne illnesses such as cyclosporiasis.

headlines.title: FDA approves daily HIV pill from Gilead designed to simplify treatment for some patients
headlines.summary: The new pill is also aimed at people who are doing well on a single-tablet regimen, including Biktarvy, and want to switch to a new treatment.

headlines.title: Gap shares jump 12% after company names new Old Navy CEO to revive struggling brand
headlines.summary: Gap announced a new CEO for Old Navy on Thursday as the brand reported a decline in comparable sales for the most recent quarter.

headlines.title: Family offices are making a bullish bet on the stock market, according to CNBC Family Office Portfolio Tracker
headlines.summary: The data includes the portfolios of hundreds of family offices, representing a total of $1.4 trillion in assets.

headlines.title: American Airlines adds batch of new international routes on its XLR planes
headlines.summary: American is adding seven routes to its 2027 schedule, with the majority heading to smaller European cities from its Philadelphia hub or from New York City.

headlines.title: What the Buss family Lakers dispute can teach the wealthy about trusts
headlines.summary: Jeanie Buss, governor of the Lakers, is contesting her siblings' decision to sell the family's remaining stake in the NBA team.

headlines.title: Lost in limbo: Where the Paramount merger delay leaves WBD, and what may come next
headlines.summary: Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery is stalled due to an antitrust lawsuit, leaving WBD in limbo during a pivotal moment for media.

headlines.title: Hyundai has grown more than any automaker in the U.S. — and it s not done yet
headlines.summary: The South Korean automaker wants to keep going by ramping up production at a new $7.6 billion plant in Georgia to capture more sales and market share.

headlines.title: HHS plans new FDA deputy commissioner roles for technology and drugs, sources say
headlines.summary: HHS plans to name two deputy commissioners for technology and drugs, said two sources familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: Dick s Sporting Goods stock falls 30% as retailer misses expectations, cites challenging footwear market
headlines.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods reported fiscal second-quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.

headlines.title: United Airlines adds 2027 flights spanning Sardinia to Okinawa. Here s what it says about travel today
headlines.summary: United is betting big on premium, international travel with a host of new routes.

headlines.title: Investor competition for commercial real estate sees strongest growth in a year
headlines.summary: Even though macro uncertainty and volatility continue to show up in the broader economy, bidding keeps rising, according to JLL.

headlines.title: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac says the future of supercars is old-school combustion engines
headlines.summary: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac told CNBC he thinks high-end sports cars will continue to have combustion engines "for a very long time" even with the rise of EVs.

headlines.title: Lego posts record first-half revenue, CEO touts strong sales at high-end and value pricing
headlines.summary: Lego CEO Niels Christiansen told CNBC the company is seeing strong sales at both ends of the pricing spectrum.
